name: cp-skill-convert
tagline_zh: 把随手写的文字变成正经笔记：自动补 frontmatter、按标题改名、修好断掉的链接。不用手动整理，一步到位。
tagline_en: Turn loose text into a real note: auto-add frontmatter, rename file to title, fix broken backlinks. One step, no.
desc_en: Convert notes between types. Currently supports text to note by adding unverified structured frontmatter, renaming the file to match the title, and fixing backlinks. Use with a note path or note name.
why_zh: 同类工具只做格式化，它却连文件名和反向链接一起修，让笔记真正融入你的知识库。
why_en: Others just format; this one also renames the file and repairs backlinks, so the note truly fits your vault.
